title: Disagreeing in a Meeting
titleZh: 在會議上表達不同意見
summaryZh: 會議上有人反對功能一次全面上線，最後協議先開放百分之五的帳號試行。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I want to push back on this, and I'd rather do it here than in a hallway afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我想對這件事提出反對，而且我寧願當場講，也不要事後在走廊上講。
sentences.note: I'd rather 的 d 幾乎消失，連成 /aɪ ˈɹæ.ðɚ/；than in 連讀成 /ðə.nɪn/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Go ahead, though I'll admit I thought we'd more or less landed on this two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 你說吧，不過老實講我以為兩週前我們大致上已經定案了。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: We landed on the goal, but I never signed off on shipping to everyone on day one.
sentences.zh: 我們是對目標達成共識，但我從來沒同意第一天就全面開放。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: The whole point of a staged rollout is that it slows us down for no real reason.
sentences.zh: 分階段上線的重點，就是它會毫無理由地拖慢我們的速度。
sentences.note: point of 的 t 在 n 後面常整個脫落，連成 /ˈpɔɪ.nəv/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That's only true if you assume nothing breaks, which has not been our track record lately.
sentences.zh: 那要建立在什麼都不會出錯的前提上，而這陣子我們並沒有這種紀錄。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: You're bringing up the March outage again, and honestly, that feels like it's beside the point here.
sentences.zh: 你又提三月那次當機了，老實說我覺得那跟這件事沒什麼關係。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: It's the whole point, because we spent a week apologizing to customers who had no warning.
sentences.zh: 那正是重點，因為我們花了一整週向毫無預警的客戶道歉。
sentences.note: spent a 的 t 在 n 後常整個脫落，聽起來像 /ˈspɛ.nə/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: So what would actually satisfy you here, given that we can't just sit on this feature forever?
sentences.zh: 那到底要怎樣你才會滿意？我們總不能把這個功能永遠壓著吧。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Give it to five percent of accounts for a week, and let the numbers make the argument.
sentences.zh: 先給百分之五的帳號用一週，讓數字自己來說話。
sentences.note: Give it to 連成 /ˈɡɪ.vɪ.ɾə/，it 的 t 變閃音，to 弱讀。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: And if the numbers look fine after a week, you'll drop the objection and we go wide?
sentences.zh: 那如果一週後數字沒問題，你就撤回反對，我們全面開放？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I will, and I'll say so in writing, because I'm not trying to win anything here.
sentences.zh: 我會，而且我會白紙黑字寫下來，因為我不是要爭輸贏。
sentences.note: not 在這裡是對比重音，重讀 not 才聽得出他強調自己不是在爭輸贏。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Fine, I can live with five percent, as long as nobody treats that week as an excuse to stall.
sentences.zh: 好，百分之五我可以接受，只要沒人拿那一週當拖延的藉口。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Nobody's stalling, and if it holds up I'd honestly love to be wrong about the risk.
sentences.zh: 沒有人要拖，如果撐得住，我真心樂意在風險這件事上被證明是錯的。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Let's write it down before we leave, because I don't want to relitigate this on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 散會前先寫下來，我不想星期四又把這件事重吵一遍。
sentences.note: don't want to 口語連成 /ˈdoʊn.wɑ.nə/；write it down 的 t 變閃音。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Agreed, and I'll own the write-up so it doesn't sit in somebody's drafts all week.
sentences.zh: 同意，紀錄我來寫，免得它在誰的草稿匣裡躺一整週。

questions.q: What is speaker A actually objecting to?
options: Releasing it to all users at once

questions.q: How would you describe A's tone during the disagreement?
What do the two of them finally agree to do?
options: Release to five percent of accounts first
